AlgoSec Horizon Platform

Secure application connectivity across your hybrid environment

Horizon Solution Brief
Schedule a demo

AlgoSec Horizon is the industry's first AI powered, application-centric security management platform for the hybrid network environment. Gain deep visibility, automate security changes and ensure continuous compliance across your datacenter and multi-cloud network

Streamlining Connectivity & Security with AlgoSec Horizon

Applications are the backbone of modern business, but managing their connectivity across hybrid environments is increasingly complex. Disparate systems, security risks, and compliance demands add to the challenge. Futureproofing cloud and datacenter security convergence, the AlgoSec Horizon platform unifies on-premises and cloud environments, ensuring seamless connectivity, robust security, and continuous compliance.
